name: Rina Ashford
source: Rina is an exchange student from America and as such is not entirely familiar with Japan and its culture. She's very impulsive and tends to yell and swear a lot when things don't go her way. She's a fan of punk rock and tries to fit in with the rest of the members of the Light Music Club.
translation: Rina is an exchange student from America and as such is not entirely familiar with Japan and its culture. She's very impulsive and tends to yell and swear a lot when things don't go her way. She's a fan of punk rock and tries to fit in with the rest of the members of the Light Music Club.
